About Tech Force

Proven Since 2025.

Rilex Networks LLC. is a full-service low-voltage contractor specializing in structured cabling systems and network infrastructure solutions. We provide the design, installation, testing, certification, and support of copper and fiber optic cabling systems for a wide range of technologies.

From new construction and renovations to system upgrades and troubleshooting, Tech Force delivers turnkey solutions designed to support commercial, industrial, healthcare, transportation, and enterprise environments.

About Our Company
What We Do

Our Services

Data and Voice Cable Installation

Structured cabling, network and data center builds, IT closet buildouts and relocations, WiFi access point deployment. High-performance installations tested and certified to EIA/TIA-568 standards.

Learn More

Fiber Optics and High-Speed Data

Single mode and multi-mode fiber installation, splicing, testing, certification, and demarc extensions. Built for the bandwidth demands of today's commercial networks.

Learn More

Security Integration and Camera Systems

Access control, IP and analog camera installation, intrusion detection, and integrated security systems matched to your facility's protection requirements and budget.

Learn More
Our Capabilities

What Tech Force Delivers

Structured Cabling Systems

Bring your data, voice, and WiFi up to date with the correct infrastructure to handle the speeds and bandwidth your company needs. From fiber optic backbone to the final patch cord, Tech Force is there every step of the way. Every company, large and small, needs to provide the information technology for their business to survive in today's digital world. We can help you achieve your goals for data, WiFi access points, and voice, whether analog or IP.

Learn More

Network Planning and Design

Every installation begins with an initial onsite evaluation. We take into account the technical conditions, end-user expectations, future expansion capabilities, and budgetary considerations to deliver the right design from day one.

Learn More

Access Control and Camera Systems

Protecting your property requires the correct approach in implementing your security system. Whether it be protection from outside threats or monitoring employee access, the proper access control system with the correct surveillance system working in tandem can protect you from liability in many forms. In today's world, protecting yourself is a necessity.

Learn More

Equipment Installation, Relocation and Retrofit

Building a network or data center from the ground up, getting new space, moving your IT closet, or has your IT closet become a disaster zone? Tech Force can help with all of these issues and has been hands-on in resurrecting IT closets, moving companies from one location to another, and building data centers all over the Tri-State area.

Learn More
